## resolveApprovalConfigPath() function

Resolve the canonical absolute path to the approval-provider registration file (`<home>/governance/approval.json`<!-- -->).

Every surface MUST call this rather than building the path inline, so a declaration written by one surface is read by all of them.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare function resolveApprovalConfigPath(home: string): string
```

<tbody><tr><td>

home

</td><td>

string

</td><td>

The macts home directory as an \*\*absolute\*\* path, obtained from the caller's own `getMactsHome()` helper.

</td></tr>
</tbody></table>

**Returns:**

string

Absolute path to the approval registration JSON file.

## Example

```typescript
import { resolveApprovalConfigPath } from '@macts/core'
import { getMactsHome } from './paths.js'

const configPath = resolveApprovalConfigPath(getMactsHome())
// → "/Users/alice/.macts/governance/approval.json"
```
